3edcc6055c2e1b40.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة زهران للصيانه والتشغيل عن أخصائي علاج طبيعي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض، وتحديداً في الخرج. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة الحالات المرضية، ووضع خطط العلاج الطبيعي، ومتابعة تنفيذها لضمان تحقيق أفضل النتائج للمرضى. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال العلاج الطبيعي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل الحالة المرضية للمصابين بدقة لوضع خطة وبرنامج علاج طبيعي شامل. متابعة تنفيذ خطط العلاج الطبيعي، وتسجيل البيانات العلاجية، ومراقبة مدى التقدم الصحي للمريض واستجابته للعلاج. تحديد التمارين والحركات التقويمية اللازمة، وتحديد معدلات تكرارها بالتنسيق مع الطبيب المعالج. تدليك المرضى لتحسين أداء عضلات الجسم المصاب وتدريبهم على استخدام الأثقال وبكرات الشد والآلات الرياضية وأجهزة العوارض. تنفيذ الحركات الأرضية لتقوية عضلات الأطراف والظهر والعنق، وتدريب المصاب وذويه على التمارين الواجب متابعتها من المنزل. ضبط وتنظيم الأجهزة المستخدمة في العلاج لضمان فعاليتها وسلامتها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات في مجال العلاج الطبيعي. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بالعلاج الطبيعي وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بمختلف أعمال العلاج الطبيعي. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال العلاج الطبيعي. القدرة على دراسة وتحليل الحالات المرضية بدقة. مهارات ممتازة في وضع خطط العلاج ومتابعة تنفيذها. القدرة على تدريب المرضى وذويهم على التمارين العلاجية. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي العلاج الطبيعي بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة زهران للصيانه والتشغيل في الرياض، الخرج. يتطلب الدور الالتزام بتطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة في جميع الأوقات. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل المنطقة: الرياض، الخرج الراتب: غير معلن

3eddc0ddfaee7a4f.description: About Richemont Richemont is a global leader in the luxury sector, encompassing various Houses specializing in jewelry, watches, and high-end accessories. Each Maison upholds traditions of style, quality, and craftsmanship. Richemont is committed to preserving the heritage and identity of each House while innovating and designing new products that align with their values through continuous creativity. The Role of Stock Assistant Richemont is seeking a full-time Stock Assistant in Riyadh. This role involves managing inventory, ensuring stock accuracy, and maintaining the organization of both the sales floor and back-of-house areas. The Stock Assistant will support store operations and contribute to a positive work environment. Key Responsibilities Stock merchandise onto shelves and organize the sales floor and back-of-house (BOH) areas to ensure a pleasant and safe environment. Receive shipments accurately, reporting and following up on any delays. Prepare for the annual inventory, identify discrepancies, and implement corrective actions as needed. Perform monthly cycle counts to ensure stock accuracy across all categories and report any discrepancies. Manage all after-sales cases and client repairs, monitoring them with thorough follow-up. Ensure a consistent level of key stock and provide feedback accordingly. Maintain the image of the store and BOH in line with corporate standards and brand guidelines. Ensure organization, grooming, and appearance of all areas, adhering to Visual Merchandising Standards. Participate in maintaining a positive work environment and actively support colleagues. Provide high-quality feedback and requested reports to management. Support team members by performing routine inventory tasks and following established procedures. Train and coach colleagues on handling non-routine transactional activities, stocking shelves, replenishing inventory, and presenting merchandise effectively. Perform operational tasks in adherence to established processes. Track store stationery, client catering, and drinks to ensure timely ordering. Support Visual Merchandising displays, new launches, and rotations by preparing stock and being present during changes. Prioritize workflow to meet quality and timeliness standards, utilizing performance management systems to enhance personal performance. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh. The role requires working collaboratively within a team to ensure efficient store operations and adherence to luxury retail standards.

3e65ec1161474e4d.company_name: مصنع عماد ابراهيم الفت حلواني للمعجنات
3e65ec1161474e4d.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مصنع عماد ابراهيم الفت حلواني للمعجنات عن أمين صندوق للانضمام إلى فريقه في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على الإدارة المالية والتخطيط، مع مسؤولية خاصة عن التدفقات النقدية والسيولة والتمويل. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، مما يجعله فرصة مثالية للمهنيين الطموحين لبدء مسيرتهم المهنية في بيئة ديناميكية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إدارة الأرصدة النقدية اليومية وتحليل التدفق النقدي من العمليات والاستثمار والتمويل، مع ضمان كفاية التدفقات النقدية وتوقع المدفوعات النقدية. تحليل متطلبات رأس المال في العمليات التجارية والمعاملات والالتزامات الأخرى. تقديم الدعم في وضع سياسات وإجراءات الرقابة الداخلية المتعلقة بإدارة الموازنة والنقد والائتمان والمحاسبة. تحليل وإدارة المخاطر المرتبطة بالتدفقات النقدية، وإجراء تحليل الحساسية لتقييم تقلبات التدفقات النقدية فيما يتعلق بالمخاطر التشغيلية والتمويلية. تحليل وتحديد خيارات وشروط التمويل لتتناسب مع الاحتياجات التشغيلية والاستثمارية، والسعي للحصول على مصادر التمويل والتفاوض حول شروط التمويل. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. فهم جيد لمبادئ الإدارة المالية والتدفقات النقدية. القدرة على إجراء التحليلات المالية وتقييم المخاطر. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية وقدرة على حل المشكلات. مهارات تواصل ممتازة، شفهية وكتابية. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق. الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل. بيئة العمل يقع هذا الدور في مكة المكرمة وهو وظيفة بدوام كامل. ستعمل ضمن فريق متخصص في مصنع عماد ابراهيم الفت حلواني للمعجنات، حيث تتاح لك الفرصة لتطوير مهاراتك في الإدارة المالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

3ea4472706569b56.description: About the Role مدارس المجموعة العالمية (ISG) is seeking a School Counselor to join their team in Al Khobar, Eastern region. This full-time role requires 2-5 years of experience and involves serving as a student advocate, leader, collaborator, and advisor, bringing best practices in school counseling and education. The School Counselor is a critical member of the educational team, working collaboratively with all stakeholders to deliver a comprehensive school counseling program that promotes and supports student success. Key Responsibilities Provide individual and group counseling to support students' academic, social-emotional, developmental, and future-readiness needs. Offer developmentally appropriate academic counseling and guidance, fostering positive learning habits, organization, self-advocacy, and planning skills. Deliver developmentally appropriate college, career, and future-readiness guidance based on students’ interests, strengths, values, and goals. Support students and families through school entry, transition, and departure processes, ensuring smooth adjustments to new environments. Provide preventative counseling services that support student belonging, safety, resilience, self-awareness, self-management, and responsible decision-making. Participate in the Crisis Management Team and provide appropriate intervention and support in crisis situations. Consult and collaborate with teachers, families, and staff to provide comprehensive support for students. Collaborate with leadership to design, implement, and deliver a comprehensive, developmental school counseling program. Individual Student Support The Counselor will provide targeted individual and small-group counseling interventions, utilizing student information and relevant data for effective decision-making. This includes supporting students in identifying personal, academic, and future goals, developing action plans, and advocating for their needs. Collaboration with teachers, administrators, and learning support staff is essential to address academic, social-emotional, or behavioral concerns, while maintaining clear distinctions between counseling support, classroom management, and administrative discipline. Referrals to specialists or outside agencies will be made when needs fall beyond the scope of professional counseling practice. Academic and Future Planning This role involves supporting students in developing and reviewing academic plans, course selections, and educational pathways. The Counselor will help students understand the relationship between their academic choices, interests, strengths, and future educational and career opportunities. For high school students, guidance related to university applications, admissions requirements, and career exploration is a key component. The Counselor will also collaborate with students, families, teachers, and administrators to support academic progress and determine appropriate interventions when additional support is needed. Prevention and Responsive Services The Counselor will deliver or support developmentally appropriate counseling and social-emotional learning lessons and activities, contributing to school-wide initiatives that promote student wellbeing, belonging, and a healthy school culture. In responsive services, the role includes providing counseling support to students experiencing significant distress, assisting the Child Safeguarding Designated Lead (DSL), and maintaining appropriate professional boundaries and confidentiality when responding to sensitive student and family concerns. Professional Standards and Development The School Counselor is committed to continuous professional growth, adhering to a high standard of professional conduct and ethical principles of the school counseling profession. This includes maintaining appropriate counseling records, collecting and analyzing data to evaluate services, and participating in district counseling initiatives and professional learning opportunities. The Counselor will remain current with professional standards, ethical practices, and emerging best practices in school counseling, including relevant guidance from the International School Counselor Association (ISCA).

3ec2574f0c907eb1.description: About the Role Emdad By Elm is seeking a Senior Web Developer to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position requires a minimum of 3 years of experience in developing and maintaining web applications using React. The ideal candidate will be responsible for building high-quality, responsive, and reusable user interfaces, developing new functionalities, and ensuring optimal application performance and stability. Build reusable UI components. Integrate applications with APIs and backend services. Implement user interfaces based on approved designs and requirements. Ensure responsive design across different screen sizes. Improve application interface performance, speed, and stability. Analyze and resolve bugs and technical issues. Write clean, maintainable, scalable, and reusable code. Use Git for version control and participate in code reviews. Collaborate with technical team members and stakeholders to analyze and implement requirements. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess the following qualifications and experience: A minimum of 3 years of experience in developing and maintaining web applications using React. Demonstrated ability to build high-quality, responsive, and reusable user interfaces. Proficiency in developing new functionalities and ensuring optimal application performance and stability. 3eecce54b8a79f88.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة ديار النخبة للتسويق عن أخصائي تسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يمثل هذا الدور نقطة الاتصال الأولى مع العملاء، ويتضمن مسؤوليات متعددة في مجال التسويق وخدمة العملاء. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية الرد على استفسارات العملاء عبر الهاتف ومتابعتهم وتنسيق الزيارات الميدانية. إنشاء عقود الإيجار باستخدام منصة إيجار، وإعداد عقود الوساطة العقارية. نشر إعلانات العقارات على المنصات العقارية المتخصصة. إدارة حسابات الشركة على وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي. تصميم منشورات وإعلانات بسيطة باستخدام برنامج Canva. إعداد التقارير الدورية المتعلقة باستفسارات العملاء وغيرها من التقارير المطلوبة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال التسويق أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على التعامل مع العملاء والرد على استفساراتهم بفعالية. مهارات جيدة في استخدام الحاسب الآلي وبرامج التصميم الأساسية مثل Canva. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الدورية. بيئة العمل سيعمل أخصائي التسويق بدوام كامل في مكتب المؤسسة بمدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المباشر مع العملاء والتعاون مع فريق العمل الداخلي. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق عمل في قطاع التسويق العقاري، حيث سيتمكن المرشح من تطوير مهاراته في خدمة العملاء والتسويق الرقمي وإدارة العقود. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المقابلة الشخصية والخبرة.

3e3986016ca8a377.description: About the Role Cigna Healthcare is expanding its Information Protection (CIP) team in Saudi Arabia to address evolving regulatory expectations and the regional threat landscape. This full-time Cybersecurity Analyst position is based in Riyadh and involves defending a highly regulated healthcare-insurance environment. The role requires 0-1 years of experience and offers a broad scope with significant impact within a lean team. Role Context and Objectives The Cybersecurity Analyst will manage the branch's human-risk (awareness) program, generate actionable threat intelligence for both technical and business audiences, and support regulatory assessments to ensure compliance with KSA mandates such as SAMA, NCA, and IA. The role involves close collaboration with the Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP), enterprise security teams, and business stakeholders, with an emphasis on transforming ambiguous challenges into structured, measurable outcomes. Key Responsibilities Perform alert analysis and triage on the SIEM, monitor security dashboards, and coordinate with the MSSP for anomaly resolution, escalations, and incident response follow-through. Research regionally relevant threat actors, ransomware, and campaigns; produce regular threat intelligence briefs; and package Indicators of Compromise (IOCs) into clear, actionable defensive guidance for stakeholders. Own and continuously improve the branch security awareness program, including bilingual (Arabic/English) content, and design and execute phishing simulation campaigns to reduce failure rates. Support vulnerability triage and prioritization, apply CIS Benchmarks to identify and remediate misconfigurations, and coordinate remediation with application and infrastructure owners. Support major regulatory assessments (SAMA CSF, CRFR, MVC; NCA; IA), collect and organize control evidence, and contribute to the KSA controls universe where global mandates do not apply. Translate technical findings into concise, decision-ready reports for leadership and communicate security risks clearly to both technical teams and business audiences. Performance Indicators (First 12 Months) Sustain phishing simulation failure rates at or below the 5% enterprise target across the branch workforce. Establish a reliable and repeatable threat intelligence brief that stakeholders act upon. Provide timely and well-organized evidence contributions to each major regulatory assessment cycle. Demonstrate measurable improvement in configuration compliance across in-scope systems. Experience and Work Environment This role requires 0-1 years of experience in cybersecurity or a related field. The position is full-time and based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within Cigna Healthcare's Information Protection team. The successful candidate will operate in a dynamic environment, collaborating with internal and external security partners to maintain a robust security posture.

3e3b391a9395c2b4.description: About the Role Proger *** is seeking a QA/QC Engineer to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves implementing, monitoring, and maintaining quality assurance and quality control procedures to ensure project activities, materials, and deliverables comply with approved specifications, contractual requirements, applicable standards, and project quality objectives. Role Overview The QA/QC Engineer will be responsible for conducting inspections, reviewing technical documentation, identifying non-conformities, and ensuring the effective implementation of corrective and preventive actions. The position requires a professional with 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. Key Responsibilities Develop, implement, and monitor project quality assurance and quality control procedures. Ensure project activities and deliverables comply with approved specifications, standards, and contractual requirements. Review and monitor Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), method statements, and quality control documentation. Conduct quality inspections and audits to verify compliance with project requirements. Identify, document, and follow up on non-conformance reports (NCRs) and corrective actions. Monitor the implementation of corrective and preventive actions and verify their effectiveness. Review material submittals, technical documents, and inspection records to ensure compliance with project specifications. Coordinate with project teams, consultants, contractors, and suppliers to address quality-related issues. Monitor quality performance and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Prepare and maintain quality reports, inspection records, audit findings, and related documentation. Support internal and external quality audits and ensure timely closure of audit findings. Ensure compliance with applicable international standards, Saudi regulations, and project quality management requirements. Promote quality awareness and ensure consistent implementation of quality procedures across project activities. Check design and interface submissions for completeness and traceability. Track review comments and verify close-out evidence in the approved project systems. Perform inspections and NCR follow-up within the agreed scope and refer approvals to the designated party. Undertake any additional related and similar activities consistent with the expertise required to complete assigned tasks. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in quality assurance and quality control roles. Demonstrated ability to implement and monitor quality procedures effectively. Proficiency in reviewing technical documentation and conducting inspections. Experience with non-conformance reporting and corrective/preventive actions. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, offering an opportunity to contribute to significant projects within a professional setting. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

3e7667ba2a06507d.description: About the Graduate Programme Mace Consult offers a two-year Graduate Programme designed to provide hands-on experience and contribute to projects from the start. Participants will engage in meaningful work, shaping sustainable places, developing infrastructure, and addressing client challenges. The programme combines structured on-the-job learning with professional development and mentoring, offering exposure to various business areas. The Opportunity: PMO & Planning Graduate This full-time PMO & Planning graduate role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with a start date in early September 2027. The position involves working at Mace's Riyadh office or at client locations within the Kingdom. While most projects are in Riyadh, some may be located approximately 40km outside the city. Flexibility and an adaptable approach to travel are essential, and eligible business travel expenses are reimbursed. Responsibilities Gain practical experience on live projects within multidisciplinary teams across the built environment. Support project delivery, planning, design coordination, cost and commercial management, sustainability, risk, data analysis, or client engagement, depending on the specific role. Participate in structured learning, professional development, and mentoring activities. Build professional networks through community initiatives, industry events, and collaboration across teams and locations. Work towards a relevant professional qualification. Required Qualifications and Experience Completion of, or eligibility to complete by September 2027, a bachelor’s degree or higher in one of the following subjects: Architecture or Architectural Design BIM Building Surveying CIAT-accredited bachelor’s degree or higher in Architectural Technology Civil or Structural Engineering Construction Management Design Management Digital Construction Engineering Project Management Quantity Surveying Any other built environment-related subject 0-1 years of professional experience. For roles at client or project sites difficult to reach by public transport, a fully valid driving licence or access to a vehicle for daily commuting is required. Candidate Profile We seek ambitious and proactive individuals who demonstrate creative thinking, a positive response to change, and integrity. Candidates should align with Mace's values, behaviours, and competencies, which include: Values: Safety first, client focus, create opportunity, integrity. Behaviours: Curious, collaborators, contributors, champions of inclusion. Competencies: Build effective teams, embrace change, solve problems, build trusted relationships. Application Process Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and the vacancy may close early if a sufficient number of applications are received. 3ef93b615e53950d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المعمر لأنظمة المعلومات عن مطور تطبيقات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تصميم وتطوير وتثبيت وصيانة حلول التطبيقات بما يتوافق مع متطلبات العملاء. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال تطوير التطبيقات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استلام وفهم خطط تصميم التطبيقات، ثم إعداد خطط مفصلة لكتابة الأكواد البرمجية واختبارها، مع تحديد الإطار الزمني ومراحل التنفيذ. تطوير الأكواد البرمجية للتطبيقات باستخدام لغات البرمجة المناسبة، وتجميعها في برامج تنفيذية جاهزة للاستخدام. نشر التطبيقات على أجهزة العملاء وتنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى اختبار المنتج وإجراء التشغيل التجريبي للتأكد من فعاليته. توثيق جميع إجراءات تطوير التطبيقات بشكل دقيق، لتسهيل التحديثات والتغييرات المستقبلية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال تطوير التطبيقات. فهم قوي لمفاهيم تصميم التطبيقات وتطويرها. القدرة على كتابة أكواد برمجية نظيفة وفعالة. المهارات والكفاءات إتقان لغات البرمجة ذات الصلة بتطوير التطبيقات. مهارات ممتازة في حل المشكلات والتحليل. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والالتزام بالمواعيد النهائية. مهارات توثيق جيدة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. سيعمل المطور ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة المعمر لأنظمة المعلومات، حيث يساهم في تقديم حلول تقنية مبتكرة للعملاء. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية التوظيف. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة للتقدم لهذه الفرصة.

3ef946e18a255177.description: About MBRF MBRF is a company that supports thousands of families globally by nourishing life through quality, innovation, and its dedicated workforce. This full-time role for a Senior MRP Analyst (Procurement) is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. Role Overview The Senior MRP Analyst (Procurement) will lead the end-to-end Material Requirements Planning (MRP) for indirect materials, specifically supporting the new Jeddah factory. This role focuses on ensuring material availability for production and maintenance while optimizing inventory and working capital. The position requires 5-10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Lead end-to-end Material Requirements Planning (MRP) for indirect materials supporting the new Jeddah factory, ensuring availability for production and maintenance while optimising inventory and working capital. Run the indirect-material planning cycle, validate system-generated requirements against operational demand, maintain planning parameters and monitor shortages, overdue orders and supply exceptions. Coordinate demand, priorities and material availability with Maintenance, Production, Procurement, Warehouse, Finance, Quality, HSE, IT and suppliers. Optimise inventory policies based on material criticality, consumption, replenishment lead time and service risk. Review inventory value, coverage, turnover, inactive, excess, obsolete and non-moving stock; coordinate actions to consume, transfer, return, cancel, reschedule or dispose of materials. Maintain accurate material master, planning and supplier data in SAP; apply MBRF global material-management standards, planning routines, controls and reporting requirements. Prepare inventory-health reports and governance and audit evidence. Identify supply, inventory, data-quality and process risks, and implement corrective actions. Develop dashboards and exception-based controls, and lead improvements that reduce manual work, lead time, waste and recurring planning issues. Manage an indirect-material inventory of approximately USD 5 million, balancing service levels, operational continuity and working capital. Experience and Qualifications A minimum of 5-10 years of relevant experience in Material Requirements Planning or a related field. Demonstrated ability to manage and optimize inventory levels. Experience with SAP or similar ERP systems for material management and planning. Strong analytical skills for identifying risks and implementing corrective actions. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, supporting operations for the new Jeddah factory. The role involves coordination with various internal departments and external suppliers to ensure operational continuity.

3e0b6d82e57f9941.description: About the Role Eram Talent is seeking a Fire Safety Engineer for a full-time position in Saudi Arabia. This role involves delivering technical fire and life safety engineering activities across KAUST, under the guidance of the Fire Safety Engineering Lead. The position supports KAUST's Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) governance framework by conducting technical reviews, field assessments, inspections, and compliance verification. Key Responsibilities Conduct fire and life safety engineering reviews, assessments, inspections, and field verifications. Review fire safety requirements for new construction, renovations, research facilities, high-hazard areas, and fire protection systems. Ensure compliance with Saudi Building Code (SBC), National Fire Protection Association (NFPA), International Fire Code (IFC), KAUST requirements, and Saudi Civil Defense requirements. Conduct fire risk assessments, inspections, system verification, and compliance checks, recommending corrective actions as needed. Review and maintain fire safety documentation, drawings, test certificates, inspection records, ITM records, and deficiency closure evidence. Coordinate with Projects, Facilities, contractors, consultants, Fire & Emergency Services, and other stakeholders to resolve fire safety issues. Provide technical assurance for Inspection, Testing & Maintenance (ITM) of fire protection systems and monitor corrective actions. Participate in testing, commissioning, acceptance, and functional verification of fire alarms, suppression systems, smoke control, passive fire protection, fire doors, barriers, and egress systems. Support investigations of fire incidents, unwanted alarms, system failures, and impairments, including root cause analysis and corrective actions. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Fire Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. Minimum of 6 years of professional experience in fire protection engineering, fire systems engineering, fire prevention, or fire & life safety compliance. Experience with fire protection system inspection, testing, commissioning, and compliance. Strong knowledge of SBC, NFPA, IFC, and preferably Saudi Civil Defense requirements. Experience reviewing fire protection designs, technical drawings, specifications, inspection reports, testing documents, and compliance records. Experience with deficiency management, corrective actions, and closeout. Experience working in complex environments such as universities, research facilities, industrial facilities, healthcare, mixed-use communities, or large campuses. Valid Saudi/GCC driver's license or valid driver's license as applicable. Preferred Certifications Fire safety/protection certifications such as CFPS, CFPE, CFAITMS, CWBSP, NICET, IFE, or equivalent are preferred. Application Process Candidates meeting the above requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

3e2a561d743b2290.description: About Sadara Chemical Company Sadara Chemical Company, located in Al Jubail, Eastern Province, is seeking a Sr. Console Operator to join its team. This is a full-time position requiring 0-1 years of experience, focusing on the safe and effective operation of plant equipment and automated systems. Role Purpose The primary purpose of the Sr. Console Operator is to ensure the safe and effective operation of plant equipment, consoles, and automated systems. This role is critical for optimizing task efficiency and adhering to established procedures within the plant environment. Key Responsibilities Operate various plant equipment, perform minor maintenance, and handle heavy lifting as required. Execute assigned operational tasks in accordance with the Task List. Adhere strictly to operating discipline principles, procedures, and practices to ensure safe and efficient plant operations. Monitor and respond to operating and error messages, reporting equipment malfunctions to supervisors for resolution. Ensure strict compliance with EH&S guidelines, regulatory requirements, and permit conditions. Respond immediately and vigilantly to emergency situations, following all established emergency protocols and procedures. Apply process knowledge and skills to continuously improve plant performance and operating discipline. Utilize operational knowledge and expertise to troubleshoot process-related deviations and issues. Issue work permits as necessary for activities within the assigned area. Perform any additional job-related activities as requested by the immediate supervisor or manager. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 0-1 years of relevant experience is required for this role. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Al Jubail, Eastern Province, and involves working within a dynamic industrial plant environment where safety and operational efficiency are paramount.

3e5483f54bdaff3f.description: About the Role GCC Olayan is seeking a Warehouse Supervisor to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves overseeing daily warehouse operations to ensure efficient receiving, storage, inventory control, picking, and dispatch of materials. The supervisor will maintain stock accuracy, optimize warehouse space and resources, and ensure compliance with safety standards to support timely and reliable business operations. Key Responsibilities Supervise the receiving, inspection, storage, picking, packing, issuing, and dispatching of materials. Verify incoming goods against purchase orders and delivery documents, reporting discrepancies and damages. Ensure accurate and timely fulfillment of customer orders and internal material requests. Maintain proper stock rotation, storage locations, labeling, and warehouse space utilization. Supervise warehouse personnel, assign tasks, monitor performance, and provide on-the-job training. Ensure proper use, handling, and maintenance of warehouse equipment. Enforce warehouse safety procedures, equipment operating guidelines, and company policies. Planning and Development Organize daily warehouse activities and allocate manpower and equipment according to operational requirements. Plan and conduct cycle counts and physical inventory checks to maintain stock accuracy. Monitor inventory levels and storage capacity to support efficient material flow. Identify and implement improvements in warehouse processes, productivity, inventory accuracy, and cost efficiency. Recommend measures to minimize stock losses, damages, and discrepancies. Stakeholder Coordination and Reporting Coordinate with Procurement, Logistics, Production, Sales, and other relevant departments to ensure timely material movement. Escalate inventory discrepancies, damaged goods, equipment issues, and operational risks to relevant stakeholders. Monitor warehouse performance against KPIs, including inventory accuracy, order fulfillment, dispatch timeliness, productivity, and stock discrepancies. Prepare and submit inventory reports, cycle count results, and warehouse performance updates. Report safety incidents, operational issues, and resource requirements to the line manager. Record Keeping Maintain accurate records of goods received, goods issued, stock transfers, returns, and inventory adjustments. Ensure warehouse transactions and inventory records are accurately updated in SAP or other relevant ERP/Warehouse Management Systems. Maintain documentation related to stock counts, equipment inspections, and warehouse safety compliance. Qualifications and Experience 3–4 years of relevant warehouse experience, including supervisory responsibilities. Experience range of 2-5 years is required.

3e61c120f062979a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اكاف العربية عن عاملة تعبئة وتغليف للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان تعبئة المنتجات وتغليفها بشكل صحيح وفعال، مع الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تعبئة المنتجات داخل العبوات أو الأكياس المخصصة لها. إغلاق العبوات والتأكد من سلامة عملية التغليف. وضع الملصقات التعريفية اللازمة على المنتجات. فرز المنتجات وترتيبها بناءً على النوع أو الصنف. التأكد من خلو العبوات من أي تلف أو عيوب ظاهرة قبل التعبئة. ترتيب المنتجات المعبأة في الأماكن المخصصة لها داخل المستودع أو منطقة التخزين. المحافظة على نظافة وترتيب منطقة العمل بشكل مستمر. الالتزام بتعليمات مشرف الإنتاج وتوجيهاته. الإبلاغ الفوري عن أي ملاحظات أو مشكلات تتعلق بالمنتجات أو أدوات العمل. الالتزام بإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية أثناء أداء جميع المهام. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التعبئة والتغليف أو ما شابه. القدرة على العمل بدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل لضمان جودة التغليف. الالتزام بمعايير النظافة والسلامة في بيئة العمل. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الفرصة في مدينة مكة المكرمة، وتتطلب التزاماً بالعمل بدوام كامل. يتم العمل ضمن فريق لضمان سير عمليات التعبئة والتغليف بسلاسة وفعالية. المزايا تقدم الشركة راتباً شهرياً يتراوح بين 3,750 ريال سعودي و 5,625 ريال سعودي، وذلك حسب الخبرة والمؤهلات. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في شركة اكاف العربية.

3e8f95234db0dd69.description: About Uxbert Labs Uxbert Labs is a digital and user experience design agency in the GCC, working with regional and international brands. As part of the Supertech Group, Uxbert Labs is connected to Hala Yalla, Saudi’s #1 private event ticketing platform, and Kafu Games, the largest esports tournament platform in MENA. Role Overview Uxbert Labs is seeking a CEO/Commercial Growth Partner with over 10 years of experience for a full-time position. This role focuses on driving the commercial and market expansion of Uxbert Labs. It is designed for a seasoned commercial leader experienced in scaling service-based companies, understanding consulting and digital transformation dynamics, and identifying high-value opportunities across government, enterprise, and global markets. The CEO/Commercial Growth Partner will shape and execute the company’s growth strategy, focusing on revenue acceleration, sales expansion, global positioning, and strategic partnerships to strengthen Uxbert Labs' presence in UX/CX, software development, and AI-powered digital transformation. Key Responsibilities Lead the company’s commercial growth strategy, focusing on revenue expansion and new market penetration. Develop and execute plans to secure large enterprise and government opportunities. Build high-level relationships with C-suite clients, partners, and strategic allies. Drive global and regional market-entry opportunities. Secure partnerships with technology providers, consulting firms, and channel partners to accelerate Uxbert’s reach. Develop long-term alliances supporting UX/CX, digital transformation, and AI services. Represent the company in international conferences, forums, and government engagements. Oversee high-value bids, proposal strategies, pricing frameworks, and negotiations for mega deals. Build new commercial models and explore diversification of revenue streams (training, AI products, managed services, etc.). Strengthen sales forecasting, pipeline visibility, and revenue planning. Build and develop a high-performing commercial and sales organization. Define go-to-market strategies for UX, CX, QA services, software development, digital transformation, and AI consulting. Introduce systems for lead generation, partner-led sales, and enterprise outbound growth. Develop commercial strategies around AI products, platforms, and consulting services. Build the company’s thought leadership globally through events, keynotes, and media visibility. Identify market gaps and propose new AI-driven business opportunities. Work closely with the General Manager to ensure commercial commitments align with operational capability. Support strategic decision-making with market insights, competitive analysis, and commercial intelligence. Collaborate with PMO, Tech, Design, Research, and AI teams to ensure smooth handover from sales to delivery. Own commercial KPIs: Revenue growth, New markets, Partnerships, Bid conversions, Pipeline scaling. Work with finance to optimize pricing, margins, and commercial structures without interfering in operational budgets. What We Offer Opportunity to lead and scale a company with a strong legacy, credibility, and mega-project experience. A strategic partnership role with high autonomy and influence. A culture of innovation, agility, and forward-thinking. Competitive compensation package and performance-linked incentives. Role Impact This role is critical for Uxbert Labs as it enters a phase of accelerated growth. The CEO/Commercial Growth Partner will be instrumental in expanding the company regionally and globally, unlocking untapped commercial potential, and transforming it into a dominant digital and AI consulting powerhouse. The prime focus areas for this role are revenue, partnerships, market entry, and global expansion.

3ecc24b164973544.description: About the Role Robusta is seeking an Application Architect to define, maintain, and govern the Application Architecture across enterprise and banking environments. This full-time role focuses on developing current-state and target-state application landscapes, defining application and integration standards, and ensuring application designs align with approved Enterprise Architecture. The position requires 5-10 years of experience. Role Context and Collaboration The Application Architect will work closely with Solution Architects, Enterprise Architects, Security, Data, Infrastructure, and development teams. This collaboration supports application modernization, rationalization, integration, and transformation initiatives, ensuring that application architecture effectively supports business capabilities and requirements. Key Responsibilities Define and maintain the Application Architecture and application landscape. Develop and maintain current-state and target-state application architectures. Define application architecture principles, standards, and guidelines. Design application components and define their relationships and dependencies. Define and maintain integration and API architecture. Assess application dependencies, impacts, and technology risks. Identify gaps between current-state and target-state application architecture. Ensure application designs comply with approved Enterprise Architecture standards. Review and approve application architecture and solution designs. Support application modernization, rationalization, and transformation initiatives. Maintain the application repository, architecture models, and related documentation. Monitor compliance with approved application architecture standards and principles. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field. 7+ years of experience in Application Architecture, Solution Architecture, Software Architecture, or related roles. Experience in banking or financial services is preferred. Experience working in a SAMA-regulated environment is an advantage. Strong experience in application architecture and application landscape design. Strong understanding of API, integration, and distributed application architectures. Experience with application modernization, rationalization, and transformation. Good understanding of Enterprise Architecture principles and frameworks. Experience with architecture governance, design reviews, and technology standards. Strong understanding of application dependencies, interfaces, and integration patterns. TOGAF, AWS/Azure Architecture, or similar certification is preferred. Required Skills Strong analytical skills. Effective problem-solving abilities. Excellent communication skills. Proficient in stakeholder management.

3ec806f99cb19da6.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة هاتفي ثري التجارية عن أخصائي مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتنفيذ سياسات واستراتيجيات المبيعات، مع متابعة الأداء وتقييم النتائج لضمان تحقيق الأهداف المحددة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة ومتابعة تطورات السوق لتحديد وتطوير الأهداف التسويقية وطرق البيع، وتقدير حجم المبيعات المتوقع، وترجمة الأهداف إلى خطط بيعية فعالة. اقتراح سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى وضع وتقييم البرامج الترويجية. التواصل مع الزبائن لتحديد مشكلاتهم، ومتابعة المنافسين وبرامجهم البيعية لتجنب المخاطر المستقبلية المحتملة. تقييم نتائج أعمال مندوبي البيع ومدى تحقيق الأهداف البيعية، واقتراح الخطط والإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو ما يعادله. القدرة على وضع سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم النتائج. مهارات تحليلية قوية لدراسة السوق وتحديد الأهداف. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتفاعل مع الزبائن والزملاء. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. مهارات حل المشكلات واتخاذ القرارات. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مؤسسة هاتفي ثري التجارية في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

3eedd3e1bd227e9d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أباريل للتجارة عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء، ترويج المنتجات، وإتمام عمليات البيع بكفاءة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، مما يجعله فرصة مناسبة للمرشحين الطموحين في بداية مسيرتهم المهنية. الهدف من الوظيفة يهدف شاغل هذه الوظيفة إلى جمع البيانات والمواصفات المتعلقة بالمنتجات، وإعداد قاعدة بيانات شاملة للعملاء. كما يتولى مسؤولية التواصل مع العملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين لتقديم عروض البيع، ومتابعة إتمام الصفقات، وتحصيل الديون، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير الدورية للعمل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بناء وتحديث قاعدة بيانات للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين، مع تضمين بياناتهم وعناوينهم وأرقام هواتفهم. التواصل مع العملاء، سواء عبر الهاتف أو الزيارات الميدانية، لترويج المنتجات (السلع والخدمات) وتقديم عروض البيع. استعراض مواصفات المنتجات وميزاتها التنافسية للعملاء. التحقق من الأسعار ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المحددة. إتمام عمليات البيع، تحرير الفواتير، وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. تحصيل ديون العملاء، تسجيلها وتوثيقها، وتوريدها إلى الدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو دور ذي صلة. القدرة على جمع البيانات وتنظيمها بفعالية. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. القدرة على إتمام عمليات البيع وتحصيل الديون. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. سيعمل المندوب ضمن فريق مبيعات ديناميكي لدعم أهداف الشركة وتحقيق النمو. التقديم إذا كنت تمتلك المؤهلات والخبرة المطلوبة وتتطلع إلى فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق أباريل للتجارة، ندعوك للتقديم لهذه الوظيفة.

3e0985e691474eeb.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة التشييد المميز للمقاولات عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في جازان. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية، ومتابعة التنفيذ، وتشخيص الأعطال، وصيانة المعدات الكهربائية ضمن المشاريع الهندسية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الكهربائية، ومتابعة مراحل التنفيذ. تطوير مخططات ومواصفات لخطوط شبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية، وتحديد مساراتها بدقة. إعداد برامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية بما يتوافق مع متطلبات العمل والمشاريع الصناعية. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة والمعدات الكهربائية، ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة اللازمة. وضع برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية بناءً على توصيات الشركات المصنعة والتعليمات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الدراسات والتحاليل، وعرضها ومناقشتها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة درجة البكالوريوس في الهندسة الكهربائية أو مجال ذي صلة. خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية. معرفة ببرامج تشغيل المعدات الكهربائية وتشخيص الأعطال. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية لتشخيص الأعطال. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. مهارات جيدة في التواصل والعرض. الالتزام بتطوير أساليب العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الكهربائي ضمن فريق مؤسسة التشييد المميز للمقاولات في مدينة جازان. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع لمتابعة المشاريع وتنفيذ المهام. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

3e2b1d2ef45136e3.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سراكو عن فني هندسة كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في عرعر، بمنطقة الحدود الشمالية. يهدف هذا الدور إلى الإشراف على تركيب وصيانة الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية، وتقديم الدعم الفني للمهندسين. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب المحركات واللوحات والمولدات والمحولات الكهربائية، والإشراف عليها ومراقبتها. تقديم المساعدة للمهندسين الكهربائيين في حل المشكلات الفنية المعقدة. تحديد المخططات وتقدير كميات المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة المطلوبة بناءً على المخططات الأولية. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والفنيين والحرفيين الآخرين المشاركين في أعمال التركيب الكهربائي. اختبار الأنظمة بعد تركيبها لضمان مطابقتها للمخططات الأولية والمواصفات المطلوبة. الصيانة والتشخيص القيام بعمليات الفحص الروتينية ضمن أعمال الصيانة الوقائية. تشخيص الأعطال والتلف المحتمل في المعدات الكهربائية واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. التحقق من الأعطال وفحص الأجزاء والمعدات المعطوبة. تشخيص المكونات التالفة وإصلاحها أو استبدالها. ضمان الاستجابة السريعة لعمليات الطوارئ للتقليل من فترات انقطاع التيار الكهربائي. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية أو مجال ذي صلة. معرفة قوية بتركيب وصيانة المحركات واللوحات والمولدات والمحولات الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الكهربائية والمواصفات الفنية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة عرعر، الحدود الشمالية. يتطلب الدور العمل ضمن فريق فني متخصص، وتقديم الدعم المستمر لضمان كفاءة الأنظمة الكهربائية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية المقابلة.

3e5173e18e3369c3.description: About the Role Larsen & Toubro is seeking a Meter Data Acquisition System (MDAS) Engineer to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time position is ideal for candidates with 0-1 years of experience, focusing on the commissioning and integration of MDAS solutions. Role Overview The MDAS Engineer will be responsible for the on-site commissioning of Meter Data Acquisition Systems, ensuring their seamless integration and compliance with client and industry standards. This role involves technical validation, troubleshooting, and coordination with various stakeholders to deliver robust automation and protection systems. Key Responsibilities Execute on-site commissioning of Meter Data Acquisition Systems (MDAS). Perform I/O checks, loop testing, logic verification, and SCADA HMI validation. Validate communication protocols including Modbus, IEC 61850, IEC 104, and DNP3. Coordinate with system integrators, OEM vendors, and internal teams to ensure seamless integration of automation and protection systems. Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to control signals, communication links, and data reporting. Ensure system compliance with client requirements and utility/grid code standards. Generate commissioning test reports, punch point lists, and comprehensive documentation. Support remote SCADA integration and participate in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) as required. Provide training and technical support to site Operations & Maintenance (O&M) staff during system handover. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in a relevant field. Demonstrated understanding of Meter Data Acquisition Systems. Familiarity with industrial communication protocols. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, requiring on-site presence for commissioning activities and coordination with various project teams and external vendors. Application Process Candidates interested in this Meter Data Acquisition System (MDAS) Engineer role are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

3e5cffceaeb19427.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة احلى رمش الغزالة عن أخصائي مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتنفيذ سياسات المبيعات، ومتابعة الأداء، وتقييم النتائج لضمان تحقيق الأهداف المحددة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة ومتابعة تطورات السوق لتحديد وتطوير الأهداف التسويقية وطرق البيع، وتقدير حجم المبيعات المتوقع، وترجمة هذه الأهداف إلى خطط بيعية فعالة. اقتراح سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى تقييم البرامج الترويجية لضمان فعاليتها. التواصل المستمر مع الزبائن لتحديد مشكلاتهم، ومتابعة المنافسين وبرامجهم البيعية لتجنب المخاطر المستقبلية المحتملة. تقييم أداء مندوبي البيع ومدى تحقيق الأهداف البيعية، واقتراح الخطط والإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو ما يعادله. القدرة على وضع سياسات بيعية ومتابعة تنفيذها. مهارات تحليلية لتقييم نتائج المبيعات وتحديد الإجراءات التصحيحية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة مع العملاء والزملاء. القدرة على تحليل بيانات السوق والمنافسين. مهارات إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وتحقيق الأهداف المحددة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مؤسسة احلى رمش الغزالة في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بتحقيق أهداف المبيعات والمساهمة في نمو المؤسسة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور لم يتم الإفصاح عنه وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

3e6b5c5181180fd3.description: About FlyAkeed FlyAkeed is an innovative online platform focused on transforming the travel booking experience by enabling seamless flight and hotel reservations. Established in 2017 and headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, we aim to simplify work-related travel planning for businesses and individuals alike. Highlights Current funding stage: Series A FlyAkeed is proudly backed by notable investors including PIF subsidiary Sanabil Investments, Elm, Artal Capital, and Alrajhi Partners. Job Summary The Senior Customer Onboarding manages the onboarding journey for new customers, ensuring their business requirements, account information, user access, and operational setup are completed accurately and on time. The role serves as a key point of contact for customers and internal teams, helping accelerate customer activation and deliver a smooth onboarding experience. Key Responsibilities Manage the end-to-end onboarding process for new customers, from initial handover through account activation. Guide customers through registration, account setup, required documentation, and implementation steps. Understand customer requirements and coordinate the configuration of accounts, user access, and platform settings. Coordinate with Sales, Account Management, Product, Technology, Finance, and Operations to complete onboarding requirements. Deliver platform walkthroughs and training to help customers and their users adopt FlyAkeed’s services effectively. Track onboarding progress, identify blockers, and proactively follow up to ensure timely activation. Provide onboarding support, respond to customer queries, and coordinate the resolution of initial setup issues. Maintain accurate customer onboarding records, trackers, and performance reports. Identify recurring onboarding challenges and recommend improvements to processes, guidance, and customer communications. Support the development of onboarding materials, templates, and standard operating procedures. Provide guidance and knowledge-sharing to other team members as needed. Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Tourism, Hospitality, or a related field. Experience in customer onboarding, customer success, account coordination, or operations. Strong coordination, communication, and stakeholder management skills. High attention to detail and ability to manage documentation and multiple customer onboarding cases. Comfortable working with digital platforms, spreadsheets, and CRM or customer management systems. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; Arabic is an advantage.

3e729911ecd4aae0.description: About Aura Centers Aura Centers is a premium fitness and wellness brand dedicated to providing a high-end, privacy-conscious experience for women in Saudi Arabia. The company operates two branches in Jeddah and is expanding into Riyadh, offering a modern environment focused on comfort, results, and professional support. Aura Centers provides services such as personal training, group classes, specialized fitness programs, Pilates, yoga, and massage therapy, alongside tailored membership plans for all fitness levels. The brand is committed to service excellence, supported by certified trainers and facilities designed to redefine women’s wellness in the region. The Role of Fitness Trainer Aura Centers is seeking a Fitness Trainer to join its team in Makkah, specifically in Jeddah. This is a full-time, on-site position. The role involves delivering personalized and group training, conducting fitness assessments, and developing structured training plans to help members achieve their wellness goals within Aura Centers' professional and supportive environment. Key Responsibilities Design and deliver individualized and group training sessions. Ensure safe and effective workouts that align with members’ goals and fitness levels. Conduct comprehensive fitness assessments for members. Create structured and progressive training plans. Demonstrate proper exercise techniques and form. Monitor member progress and adjust training plans as needed. Lead group fitness classes. Engage with members on the gym floor, providing guidance and support. Provide continuous motivation to members. Maintain a welcoming and professional atmosphere within the facility. Collaborate with colleagues to support specialized fitness programs. Contribute to membership retention efforts. Uphold Aura Centers’ standards of service, cleanliness, and member privacy. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 year of experience in fitness training. Relevant certifications in fitness training. Demonstrated ability to design and implement effective training programs. Work Location This full-time position is based on-site at Aura Centers in Jeddah, Makkah.

3e8292c1555d8f24.description: About Roche Roche is dedicated to advancing science and ensuring access to healthcare globally. With over 100,000 employees, the company focuses on preventing, stopping, and curing diseases, treating millions with medicines and conducting billions of diagnostic tests. Roche fosters a culture that values personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, empowering employees to thrive both personally and professionally. The Role of Supply Chain Director The Supply Chain Director for Roche Diagnostics Saudi Arabia is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This role serves as a strategic business partner and a key member of both the Saudi Arabia Leadership Team (SALT) and the Middle East Supply Chain Leadership Team. The Director is responsible for shaping the end-to-end supply chain model to enhance commercial value, customer loyalty, and organizational resilience. The position involves driving the strategic agenda for both leadership teams and aligning regional stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Contribute to and influence decision-making forums, building consensus in a matrixed environment. Manage complex stakeholder dynamics, balancing interests and translating risks into strategic influence. Ensure proactive and transparent communication on strategic initiatives. Plan and implement the in-country supply chain strategy in alignment with regional and global objectives. Collaborate with internal teams, chapters, and networks. Establish and monitor key supply chain performance indicators (KPIs). Liaise with the integrated planning team to optimize inventory levels for spare parts, instruments, and reagents. Manage 3PL supply chain activities to ensure timely completion. Collaborate on automation and digitalization projects with relevant teams. Lead order management and warehousing teams to ensure efficient operations and on-time deliveries. Analyze customer feedback and develop improvement action plans. Shape supply chain models to support commercial growth and optimize inventory, translating data insights into strategic recommendations. Coordinate inbound, outbound, and returns processes with 3PL partners. Develop and monitor 3PL performance to meet Roche quality standards. Collaborate with 3PLs to resolve operational issues and implement improvements. Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and Roche's ethical standards. Participate in warehouse quality and certification audits. Identify and address customer needs with clear information and resolve issues efficiently. Build and maintain positive customer relationships through active listening and empathy. Gather customer feedback to improve products, services, and internal processes. Create a motivating environment to attract, engage, and retain talent. Hire, develop, and manage employees and third-party partners for local operations. Delegate tasks, foster team decision-making, and promote open communication. Provide regular feedback, coaching, and individual development plans for employees. Required Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in supply chain management. Work Environment This is a full-time position within a global organization committed to advancing science and healthcare. The role involves working within a collaborative environment, contributing to a team of over 100,000 employees worldwide. Application Information Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Salary for this position will not be disclosed.

3ece27ecc774dfea.description: About the Role SAB is seeking a Marketing Senior Manager to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves leading marketing initiatives and managing brand-related activities within the organization. The role requires a professional with extensive experience in marketing, capable of overseeing strategic planning and execution. Key Responsibilities Manage brand activities and related initiatives. Oversee the marketing budget, Annual Operating Plan (AOP) planning, and departmental contracts. Handle major brand partnerships. Develop and manage department policies and procedures. Develop brand campaigns to maintain brand health, aligned with brand health research. Develop and manage media opportunities. Manage, update, and maintain brand guidelines. Develop creative assets in line with established brand guidelines. Manage marketing campaigns. Manage key brand sponsorships and brand activation efforts. Manage and supervise risk reporting, including heatmap and Root Cause Analysis (RCA). Develop customer awareness security campaigns. Manage branch merchandising activities. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience in Marketing or a related field of study. Approximately 10 years of experience, with a preferred 4 years in a relevant role. Required Skills Strong analytical skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, offering an opportunity to contribute to SAB's marketing strategy and brand presence.

3ee4717bbeaf6413.description: About the Role Algihaz Holding is seeking a Quantity Surveyor (QS) Engineer to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position suitable for Saudi Nationals with 0-1 years of experience in the construction industry. The role focuses on managing cost estimates, quantity requirements, and financial aspects of construction projects. Key Responsibilities Prepare comprehensive cost estimates and determine quantity requirements for projects. Review and analyze construction drawings and plans to ensure accuracy and compliance. Provide support in budgeting, contract administration, and tender preparation processes. Coordinate effectively with site teams, contractors, and subcontractors to ensure project alignment. Monitor project costs, budgets, material usage, and cash flow to maintain financial control. Qualifications and Requirements Applicants must be Saudi Nationals. Bachelor’s degree in Quantity Surveying, Civil Engineering, or a related field. 0-1 years of experience in the construction industry. Demonstrated experience in cost estimation, quantity take-off, budgeting, contracts, and tenders. Required Skills Strong analytical capabilities to assess project data and financial information. Effective negotiation skills for managing contracts and supplier relationships. Excellent communication skills for interacting with various stakeholders. Proficiency in MS Office applications. 3ef818456040ed64.description: About the Role Jazeera Paints is seeking a Tinting Technician to join our team in Khamis Mushayt, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position focused on executing precise color tinting processes and ensuring quality control within production operations. Key Responsibilities Verify that received tinting colorants and quantities match the specifications on the batch ticket. Ensure all necessary tinting colorants are available and prepared near the machine before initiating the tinting process. 3edcfefb8ee9b468.description: تعلن سلسلة مطاعم متخصصة في الوجبات الصحية عن توفر 15 فرصة وظيفية بمسمى: مساعد شيف (Assistant Chef / Commis Chef) المهام والمسؤوليات المساعدة في إعداد وتجهيز الوجبات الصحية. تجهيز المكونات وتحضير الأطعمة وفق الوصفات المعتمدة. المساعدة في أعمال الشواء والطهي. الالتزام بمعايير الجودة وسلامة الغذاء. المحافظة على نظافة وترتيب منطقة العمل. العمل بروح الفريق وتحمل ضغط العمل. شروط ومتطلبات الوظيفة خبرة سابقة في المطاعم أو المطابخ الإنتاجية. معرفة بإعداد الوجبات الصحية والتحكم في الحصص الغذائية. الإلمام بمعايير النظافة وسلامة الغذاء وHACCP. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وفي بيئة سريعة. إقامة سارية داخل المملكة. توفر أهلية نقل الخدمات. ، والتقديم متاح لجميع المؤهلين. المميزات الوظيفية راتب تنافسي يحدد حسب الخبرة والكفاءة. سكن توفره الشركة. مواصلات توفرها الشركة. بيئة عمل احترافية. فرص للتطور الوظيف

3e2a3e1f66c93093.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة روعة الطريق لتأجير السيارات عن موظف استقبال للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات، وهو مخصص للعمل بدوام كامل. يركز الدور على تقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة وإدارة عمليات تأجير المركبات بكفاءة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال العملاء بمهنية ومظهر لائق. التحقق من صحة بيانات العميل وأهليته لتأجير المركبات. عرض أنواع المركبات المتاحة للتأجير، وتوضيح التسعيرة والشروط المطلوبة. التأكد من استيفاء شروط التأجير للعميل، بما في ذلك العمر المحدد وصلاحية رخصة القيادة. ضمان قبول المستأجر للشروط المتعلقة بالتأمينات والدفع المسبق للضمان. التأكد من توقيع العقد من قبل المستأجر، وتحصيل مبلغ الإيجار، وتسليم نسخة من العقد. فحص المركبات عند الاستلام والتسليم، وتوثيق أي أضرار أو ملاحظات. معالجة شكاوى واستفسارات العملاء وفقًا لسياسات المنشأة والأنظمة المعمول بها. تحديث سجلات المركبات بشكل يومي. متابعة تحصيل مبالغ المركبات المؤجرة والتأكد من إضافتها في العقود. متابعة تفويضات المركبات والتأكد من صلاحيتها. متابعة الصيانة الدورية للمركبات المؤجرة. التأكد من جاهزية المركبات المتوفرة في الأسطول للتأجير. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع العملاء بمهنية وتقديم خدمة ممتازة. مهارات تنظيمية وإدارية جيدة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، وتتطلب الوظيفة التزامًا بالعمل بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مؤسسة روعة الطريق لتأجير السيارات. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال مراحل المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة في مؤسسة روعة الطريق لتأجير السيارات.

3e14e352d8e45f9d.description: About Marafid MARAFID, the execution arm of Riyadh Holding Company, specializes in developing and activating economic infrastructure across three core sectors: Logistics & Mobility, Industrial Clusters, and Circular Economy. The company integrates development, asset management, leasing, and strategic partnerships to deliver projects and services that support business activity and serve operators, tenants, and investors. MARAFID focuses on logistics parks, truck stations, parking facilities, specialized industrial hubs, and infrastructure for material aggregation, reuse, and recycling, supported by digital solutions and shared services. The Role of Business Development Manager MARAFID is seeking a Business Development Manager to manage and develop business and investment opportunities within its focus sectors. This full-time position, based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, involves building relationships with investors and partners, and coordinating commercial activities from opportunity identification through negotiation and contract execution. The role supports investment attraction and business growth for the company. Key Responsibilities Identify and qualify business and investment opportunities across MARAFID’s focus sectors, maintaining a qualified investor pipeline. Build and manage relationships with investors, tenants, partners, and relevant stakeholders. Manage assigned business development and investment opportunities from initiation through closure, coordinating with internal teams and external consultants. Manage the commercial aspects of RFP processes, including document preparation, bidder communications, clarifications, and bid evaluation coordination. Support commercial negotiations and prepare commercial offers, term comparisons, recommendations, and preliminary agreements such as MoUs, LOIs, and term sheets. Coordinate with Legal and relevant internal functions on contractual and commercial matters through contract execution. Track the progress and commercial performance of assigned opportunities and prepare periodic reports and executive presentations for management. Monitor market trends and sector developments to identify and propose new business and investment opportunities. The role involves collaboration with public and private sector partners to support Riyadh’s economic growth by connecting land, infrastructure, and operational expertise. 3ec8a4f783d75835.description: About Ferring Pharmaceuticals Ferring Pharmaceuticals is dedicated to advancing scientific understanding in reproductive and women’s health, gastroenterology, and urology. The company focuses on developing solutions that help individuals build families and improve their lives globally. This role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Role Summary The Medical Representative is responsible for promoting Ferring products to healthcare professionals in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves executing marketing strategies, maintaining stakeholder relationships, and gathering market intelligence. The role requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Promote Ferring products to healthcare professionals in accordance with established marketing strategies, frequency, and impact targets. Build and maintain professional relationships with healthcare professionals and other relevant stakeholders. Participate in local, regional, and international scientific congresses as determined by the company. Classify doctors and stakeholders based on segmentation and targeting criteria, proposing additions, changes, or removals from existing files. Track prescription habits, assess product perception, verify prescription potential, and evaluate influence among other doctors. 3e470680738502a3.description: About the Role GSK is seeking a Medical Representative to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah. This full-time role involves engaging healthcare professionals (HCPs) within an assigned territory to promote GSK products and solutions, aligning with the company's patient-focused approach. The position emphasizes building trust and facilitating scientific discussions to support patient care. Key Responsibilities The Medical Representative will be responsible for delivering GSK strategies and implementing activities effectively. Utilizing approved promotional materials in compliance with GSK policies, SOPs, and Saudi regulations. Conducting product detailing and scientific discussions with HCPs to support patient care. Organizing and leading group doctor meetings to share medical insights and product information. Gathering market intelligence and providing timely feedback to optimize strategies. Completing annual certifications and adhering to all related SOPs, policies, and Saudi healthcare regulations. This includes: Meeting defined efficiency and effectiveness KPIs for optimal activity execution. Ensuring proper care and use of GSK assets while optimizing company resources. 3edc02be2086f2c9.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث الشركة العالمية للمنتجات الكهربائية عن فني هندسة ميكانيكية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور على تشغيل وضبط ماكينات التحكم الرقمي بالحاسب (CNC) المستخدمة في عمليات تخريم وقص وثني الصفائح المعدنية. يهدف شاغل الوظيفة إلى ضمان تنفيذ أوامر الإنتاج بدقة وفقاً للرسومات الهندسية والمواصفات الفنية ومعايير الجودة والسلامة، مع تحقيق الكفاءة الإنتاجية وتقليل الهدر. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المساعدة في تطوير نظريات جديدة وتحسين الأساليب الحالية في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. المساهمة في عملية التصميم الشاملة، وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة. تقديم الدعم للمشاريع الهندسية، والإشراف على تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم. إعداد الجداول الزمنية وتقديرات التكلفة للمشاريع الهندسية. تقديم الدعم في أعمال صيانة النظم وتصليحها لضمان استمرارية التشغيل. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها في الشركة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تشغيل وضبط ماكينات التحكم الرقمي بالحاسب (CNC). فهم جيد للرسومات الهندسية والمواصفات الفنية. المهارات المطلوبة الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل لضمان جودة الإنتاج. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتعاون مع الزملاء. مهارات حل المشكلات واتخاذ القرارات الفعالة. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الهندسة الميكانيكية بدوام كامل في منشآت الشركة بالدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المستمر مع فرق الإنتاج والهندسة لضمان سير العمليات بكفاءة وفعالية. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق متخصص في الشركة العالمية للمنتجات الكهربائية، حيث يمكن للمرشح المساهمة في عمليات الإنتاج وتطويرها. الراتب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

3e033f85adcd67b1.description: About KBR and the Role KBR Sustainable Technology Solutions (STS) delivers comprehensive solutions across the entire asset lifecycle, encompassing licensed process technologies, advisory services, technical expertise, energy transition solutions, high-end design capabilities, and smart solutions for optimizing assets. Lead and conduct Asset Criticality Analysis for all refinery assets, including data collection, workshop facilitation, report compilation, and SAP data population. Champion the implementation of various reliability methodologies across all asset types by establishing programs to sustain operational excellence. Serve as the primary contact for reliability culture development in projects and operating facilities, providing technical guidance to safeguard asset reliability throughout its lifecycle. Administer and execute Asset Lifecycle management procedures, including Asset criticality ranking, SAP Taxonomy, Asset Operating Limits (IOW), maintenance development, Master data developments in SAP, Bill of Materials (BOM) in SAP, and active SAP-PMs implementation and effectiveness. Work closely with the project execution team to ensure commitment to the Reliability Transformation Program. Proficiency in SAP modules related to asset management and maintenance (*, SAP-PM). Work Environment This role is based in Al Jubail, Eastern, and operates on a full-time basis. The Reliability Engineer will work within a refinery environment, collaborating with various plant-wide and multidisciplinary teams to achieve reliability objectives. About KBR Sustainable Technology Solutions (STS) KBR STS is committed to providing holistic and value-added solutions across the entire asset life cycle, leveraging world-class licensed process technologies, differentiated advisory services, deep technical domain expertise, and energy transition solutions.

This role offers an opportunity to contribute to a global team dedicated to hospitality.

3ece3e63a98848b7.description: Job Summary Le Méridien Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Director of Sales & Marketing A for its location in Makkah. This full-time role is responsible for overseeing the hotel's sales department, particularly for properties with over 300 rooms during peak booking periods and significant local food and beverage revenue. The Director will manage both reactive and proactive sales efforts, provide daily leadership to the sales team, and ensure the achievement of sales targets, booking goals, and overall hotel revenue. Core Responsibilities Implement brand service strategies and initiatives across all aspects of the sales process, focusing on building value-based, long-term customer relationships to meet hotel sales objectives. Evaluate the hotel's engagement across various sales channels (*, regional sales, sales office group sales, electronic channels) and establish strong working relationships to proactively position and promote the hotel. Manage the marketing budget to develop hotel-specific activities, promotions, and collateral that drive revenue and achieve hotel goals. Collaborate with regional marketing communications to advance regional and national promotional activities. Develop and implement a hotel-wide strategy to deliver products and services that meet or exceed the needs and expectations of target customers and hotel employees, ensuring a return on investment for owners and Marriott International. Manage the development of strategic account plans based on market demand triggers. Provide customer intelligence to assess market and economic trends that may lead to changes in sales strategy. Review STAR reports and competitive shopping reports, utilizing other resources to maintain awareness of the hotel's market position. Research competitor sales team strategies to identify opportunities for increasing occupancy, RevPAR, and market share. Participate in sales strategy meetings and provide input on weekly and overall sales strategies. Propose innovative marketing concepts and deployment strategies to continuously increase market share. Evaluate and support regional sales and sales office group sales engagement and client deployment. Act as the sales liaison for the General Manager, hotel leadership team, group sales, and regional sales executives. Serve as the sales liaison and advocate for clients, and the hotel's authorized signatory for sales processes and contracts.
